newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on demand for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on demand for blue chips.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) were expected to rise slightly amid positive sentiment with investors aiming blue chips, brokers said.

"The market is likely to move upwards on buying of blue-chips. The sentiment of the market is positive. The investors see the market healthy and sound," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. The shares in engineering, cement and food sectors are likely to attract investments, brokers said.
The DSE benchmark index closed 0.04 points or 0.003 percent up at 1,215.55 on a turnover of 77.3 million taka on Wednesday.
